subject: Add token-cost capture to gate-label.js
description: Stamp each labeled row in gate-labeled.jsonl with the task's token cost, pulled from the tokenUsage the labeler already fetches via /task/detail. Headline output_tokens (per the orchestrator cost-benchmark convention "use output_tokens not net"), plus the full breakdown (input, output, cache_read) for flexibility. This makes the training data cost-aware from the start (retroactively impossible, like the schema change).
